mapper.sql: select id, task_id, task_name, person_id, person_name, period, deadline, completed, complete_time, on_time, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from sys_task_instance
mapper.select: where person_id = #{personId} and period = #{period} and del_flag = '0' order by deadline asc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_task_instance( task_id, task_name, person_id, person_name, period, deadline, completed, complete_time, on_time, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{taskId}, #{taskName}, #{personId}, #{personName}, #{period}, #{deadline}, #{completed}, #{completeTime}, #{onTime}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_task_instance set completed = #{completed}, complete_time = #{completeTime}, on_time = #{onTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
update sys_task_instance set completed = 0, complete_time = null, on_time = null, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: update sys_task_instance set del_flag = '2' where id = #{id}
update sys_task_instance set del_flag = '2' where task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: select count(*) as total, sum(case when completed = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as completed_count, sum(case when on_time = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as on_time_count from sys_task_instance where person_id = #{personId} and period = #{period} and del_flag = '0'

select count(*) as total, sum(case when completed = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as completed_count, sum(case when on_time = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as on_time_count from sys_task_instance where period = #{period} and del_flag = '0'

select count(*) as total, sum(case when completed = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as completed_count, sum(case when on_time = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as on_time_count from sys_task_instance i inner join sys_person p on i.person_id = p.id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.is_direct = '1' where (i.period = #{period} OR (i.period >= #{startDate} AND i.period <= #{endDate})) and i.del_flag = '0'
where period = #{period} and del_flag = '0' and task_id in (select id from sys_task where type = '周期性' and del_flag = '0') order by task_id, person_id
where period >= #{startDate} and period <= #{endDate} and del_flag = '0' and task_id in (select id from sys_task where type = '周期性' and del_flag = '0') order by task_id, person_id, period
where del_flag = '0' and task_id in (select id from sys_task where type = '一次性' and del_flag = '0') order by task_id, person_id
where del_flag = '0' and task_id in (select id from sys_task where type = '一次性' and del_flag = '0') and period >= #{startDate} and period <= #{endDate} order by task_id, person_id

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount FROM sys_task_instance WHERE del_flag = '0' AND task_id IN (SELECT id FROM sys_task WHERE type = '一次性' AND del_flag = '0') AND period >= #{startDate} AND period <= #{endDate}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount FROM sys_task_instance i INNER JOIN sys_person p ON i.person_id = p.id AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.is_direct = '1' WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.task_id IN (SELECT id FROM sys_task WHERE type = '周期性' AND del_flag = '0') AND (i.period = #{period} OR (i.period >= #{startDate} AND i.period <= #{endDate}))
where task_id = #{taskId} and person_id = #{personId} and period = #{period} and del_flag = '0' order by deadline asc

SELECT p.id as personId, p.name as name, COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN i.completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0) as rate FROM sys_task_instance i INNER JOIN sys_person p ON i.person_id = p.id AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.is_direct = '1' WHERE (i.period = #{period} OR (i.period >= #{startDate} AND i.period <= #{endDate})) AND i.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY rate DESC, completedCount DESC
